reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Chip supply chains and geopolitical conflict
themes.definition: AI mentioned as dependent on microchip supply chains threatened by geopolitical conflict (e.g. Taiwan Strait).
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI to semiconductor supply, chip production, or geopolitical risks to AI hardware.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages about AI governance, ethics or applications.
themes.boundary_cases: If AI is merely one item in a list of chip-dependent sectors, also code AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: It affects the microchips that power industry, defense, and artificial intelligence.

themes.label: AI named in list of chip-powered sectors
themes.definition: AI appears only as one item in a list of sectors, without discussion of AI itself.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI is incidental to an argument about another topic.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages developing a claim about AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Passing mention in a geopolitical argument counts here even if the argument is substantive about something else.

examples.quote: If oil was the fuel of the 20th century, microchips are the fuel of the 21st.

value.rationale: Single Paraguayan passage about Taiwan and geopolitical risk; AI is mentioned only incidentally as a sector dependent on microchips threatened by conflict.
